## Keywords

{{< glossary app-package process loading gpu refresh-rate resolution latency bandwidth cloud-gaming thermal-throttling >}}

## Think · Why is there a loading screen?

The game is already installed on the phone.
**Why must we wait before it starts?**

::: {.answer}
The game must be copied from slow **storage** into fast **memory**.
:::

## 2.1 From the store to the first frame

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="38%"}
- APK · IPA
- install → storage
- launch → **process** in memory
- memory full → system closes games
- **Do it together:** time a game start
:::
::: {.column width="62%"}
![](images/launch.png)
:::
::::

## Example · Cheap phone, slow loading

1500 MB of assets.

::: {.reveal}
1. 1500 MB per second → **1 second**
2. 150 MB per second → **10 seconds**
3. same game: 10 times slower, only because of storage speed
:::

## Try it 1 · Install, launch, load

a) installing fills…?
b) 900 MB at 300 MB per second?
c) starts again after a break: why?

::: {.answer}
a) storage
b) 3 seconds
c) the system closed it to free memory
:::

## 2.2 The frame on real hardware

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="38%"}
- CPU: logic · GPU: pixels
- the slower one sets the pace
- screen limits it (Hz)
- no fan → **throttling**
- **Do it together:** resolution and Hz of the lab screen
:::
::: {.column width="62%"}
![](images/cpu-gpu-pipeline.png)
:::
::::

## Example · What limits the frame rate?

CPU 20 ms · GPU 10 ms · screen 60 Hz.

::: {.reveal}
1. slower one: **20 ms** per frame
2. 1000 / 20 = **50 fps**
3. the CPU is the problem: smaller resolution would not help
:::

## Try it 2 · Frames, screens, heat

a) 120 Hz screen, game at 70 fps: new pictures?
b) 1080 × 2400: about how many pixels?
c) hot chip slows down?

::: {.answer}
a) 70
b) 2.6 million
c) thermal throttling
:::

## Try it 3 · Near or far?

a) game on a server, phone shows video?
b) local 44 ms + trip 40 + video 15?
c) suffers most from lag?

::: {.answer}
a) cloud gaming
b) 99 ms
c) a fighting game
:::

## 2.4 Device classes for gaming

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="38%"}
- phone, tablet: touch, battery
- PC: keyboard, long sessions
- console: gamepad, TV
- cloud: any screen, fast network
- **Do it together:** the right device for a game
:::
::: {.column width="62%"}
![](images/devices.png)
:::
::::

## Try it 4 · Which device class?

a) gamepad, TV, long sessions?
b) touch, battery, five minutes on the bus?
c) any screen, fast network?

::: {.answer}
a) console
b) smartphone
c) cloud gaming
:::

## Game challenge · The class survey

- Android phones · cheapest reads 120 MB per second
- iPhones, laptops, one console
- one cloud player: 90 ms trip
- one game for all

## Try it 5 · One game, many devices (harder)

a) 600 MB level on the cheapest phone?
b) cloud lag with the 90 ms trip?
c) heat matters most on…?

::: {.answer}
a) 5 seconds
b) 149 ms
c) smartphone
:::

## Summary

- install → storage · launch → process in memory
- storage speed → loading time
- slower of CPU and GPU sets the frame rate
- phones throttle when hot
- cloud: more latency, needs bandwidth
- each device class needs its own plan
